何事も順序が肝心だ。まずは艦船の[yellow]ステータスパネル[/]を確認しよう。[lime](Zキー)[]を押すことでこのパネルにアクセスできる。[n][n]画面の端から突き出ている小さな三角形の目印に気づいたかもしれない。クリックすれば手動でパネルを切り替えることができる。[n][n][yellow]ステータスパネル[/]を開いたら、艦船の[blue]シールド[/]と[lime]装甲[/]について説明する。
I think I will take your advice. Let's go slow.
This all seems really familiar, Let's go for the short version.

艦船の[blue]シールド[/]は[blue]青色[/]のバーで表され、[lime]装甲[/]は[lime]緑色[/]のバーで表される。[n][n]艦船の[lime]装甲[/]が0になると艦船は爆発し、艦船および積載しているすべての貨物を失うことになる。[n][n]艦船の[blue]シールド[/]の大部分をバイパスし、代わりに[lime]装甲[/]へ直接ダメージを与える特殊な兵器も存在する...とはいえ、通常は[blue]シールド[/]が最初に破壊される。

[blue]シールド[/]がすべて失われると、艦船は甚大なダメージを受ける危険にさらされる。[n][n]艦船の[lime]装甲[/]にダメージを受けた場合は、[yellow]ガレージ[/]施設を備えた[yellow]ステーション[/]で修理する必要がある。[n][n]修理を行わないと、艦船の生命維持装置の消耗が始まってしまう。生命維持装置が切れてしまえば致命的だ。戦闘後の[lime]装甲[/]の完全修理には少額のクレジットがかかるが、[yellow]ステーション[/]にドッキングすれば[blue]シールド[/]は自動的に再充填される。

艦船の[blue]シールド[/]と[lime]装甲[/]についての基本を理解したところで、次は[yellow]エネルギー[/]システムを見ていこう。[n][n]戦闘中において、艦船の[yellow]エネルギー[/]は非常に重要だ。電力が枯渇すればエンジンが停止し、タレットも機能しなくなる。[n][n][yellow]ステーション[/]にドッキングすれば、無料で自動的に[yellow]エネルギー[/]がチャージされる。また、近くの微小星の放射線を利用して艦船は自動的にエネルギーを再充電する。わずかな手数料で艦船を充電してくれる施設もいくつか存在する。

[yellow]エネルギー[/]の下にある[red]赤色[/]のバーは、あなたの艦船の[red]生命維持装置[/]の残量を示しています。[n][n][red]生命維持装置[/]システムは非常に重要です。時間を取ってカーターと話すことを強くお勧めします。[red]生命維持装置[/]システムとアップグレードについて詳しく教えてくれるでしょう。[n][n]艦船が船体ダメージを受けると、受けたダメージ量に応じて生命維持システムから漏洩が発生し始めます。一番下の最後のバーは速度インジケーターです。

[yellow]ステータスパネル[/]にある小さな四角いボタンに[lime]マウスオーバー[/]してみてください。[n][n]ここでは、[yellow]パイロット情報、生命維持装置、[/]および[yellow]艦船[/]の詳細ボタンを見つけることができます。[yellow]アフターバーナー[/]を切り替える追加のボタンもあります。[n][n][lime](SHIFTキー)[/]または[lime](CAPSLOCKキー)[/]、[yellow]ミッション目標[/]ボックス、そして最後に[yellow]船長のジャーナル[/]があります。[yellow]艦船ステータス[/]パネルの基本を理解したところで、[yellow]バイオメイト大学[/]の[yellow]ステーションガレージ[/]へ移動しましょう。
右側の[yellow]ステーションサービス[/]メニューの下にある[yellow]ガレージ[/]ボタンをクリックしてください。先ほど妹のジェッサと一緒に[orange]鉱石採掘機[/]を装備した場所を覚えているかもしれません。[n][n]今回は採掘ビームではなく、戦闘レーザーをインストールします。レーザーは弾薬を必要としないため、初心者には最適です。

インストールされている採掘ビームをすべて取り外しましょう。レーザー用のスペースを作る必要があります。[yellow]ガレージ[/]の上部メニューから採掘[orange]モジュール[/]を[lime]ドラッグ[/]し、艦船の[yellow]貨物ベイ[/]にドロップしてください。[n][n]また、[orange]モジュール[/]をステーションの[yellow]ストレージ[/]に[lime]ドラッグ[/]することもできます。すべてのステーションでは、無料のストレージスペースが少し提供されます。もっと必要場合は、料金を支払う必要があります。

採掘タレットを取り外したところで、[yellow]貨物ベイ[/]にある[orange]パルスx1レーザー[/]を[yellow]ガレージ[/]のどこかに[lime]ドラッグ＆ドロップ[/]してインストールしましょう。[n][n]2つ目の武器を搭載する十分なスペースがあるようです。通常、私はモジュールスロットを空けたままにすることはありませんが、必要であれば[yellow]マーケット[/]から2つ目のレーザーを購入できます...ただし、まだ使用できないものは購入しないでください。高レベルの[orange]モジュール[/]は多くのスキル訓練を必要とするため、基本的なものに固執してください。
出発の準備が整ったようです。合図をしていただければ、交戦用の標的ドローンを展開します。要約すると、[lime]シールド[/]と[lime]装甲[/]に注意を払ってください。[n][n]ここ[yellow]ボイド・スタークロス[/]では、[red]生命維持装置[/]は問題なく機能するはずです。ここの環境は穏やかです。それでは、準備はいいですか？
今はいい、後で戻ってくる。

まだであれば、右側のステーションメニューにある[yellow]ドック解除[/]ボタンを[lime]クリック[/]してください。[n][n]ドック解除後、ミッションのターゲットを探す必要があります。[yellow]タクティカルセンサー[/]を使用して[cyan]ターゲットドローン[/]を見つけてください。[n][n][lime](スペースキー)[/]を使用してセンサーを切り替えます。[n][n][yellow]黄色[/]の点を見つけたら、[lime]クリック[/]して艦船の[yellow]ターゲット[/]コンピューターにスキャンします。
手伝ってくれてありがとう。

ターゲットがスキャンされ、[yellow]ターゲット[/]システムで選択されている状態で、[lime](Tキー)[/]を押します。[n][n][lime](Eキー)[/]を押すことで、艦船の自動操縦を簡単にオン/オフできます。艦船がターゲットに向かって移動している今、アフターバーナーを使用するとよいでしょう。[n][n][lime]左Shift[/]を押し続けてみてください。これは短時間の推力バーストに最適です。[lime]CAPSLOCK[/]でオンとオフを切り替えます。

[orange]パルスx1レーザー[/]を起動する時間です。画面下部にあるそれを[lime]クリック[/]して有効化します。モジュールが電力供給を受け、ターゲットの射程に入るまで待機する様子を確認できます。[n][n]各モジュールには可動限界があるため、カバレッジを最大化するためにステーションの[yellow]ガレージ[/]で[orange]モジュール[/]の向きを回転させることがよくあります。[n][n]それらの[orange]モジュール[/]が射程に入ると、自動的に発砲を開始します。

[cyan]ターゲットドローン[/]を片付けたら教えてくれ。大したことではないはずだ。[yellow]コンテナ[/]の中に浮いているかもしれない戦利品を探すのも忘れるなよ。艦船は時々戦利品コンテナをドロップすることがある。もしドロップしたら、それを[yellow]ターゲット[/]し、射程内まで飛行して[yellow]コンテナ[/]を開くことで回収できる。[n][n]一度開けば、[yellow]コンテナ[/]から艦船の[yellow]貨物ベイ[/]へ貨物を移すことができる。いつもそうなるわけではないが、そうなった場合は、それらの追加アイテムを[yellow]マーケット[/]で売却して利益を得ることができる。
準備ができたら、[yellow]Biomate University[/]ステーションに戻ってこのチュートリアルミッションを完了してくれ。戻ってきたら小さな報酬を用意して待っているよ。

So where should we get started?
I guess so, but where am I?

You are currently docked at a station. One of our salvage drones found your cryo-evac pod floating out there in the void.[n][n]If you prefer, I can catch you up on everything you missed, or we can just go through the training checklist together. It's up to you, I am just so excited to be here with you.
Okay, but just give me the basics, I want to get out there.

We don't know everything, but here is what we have gathered up to this point. We were all in transit aboard the Imperium to a place called the Oasis. We don't know where that is, or even what the Oasis is. We do know this, something went horribly wrong, and now we're stranded out here. [r]It sound a lot worse than it is. We have come to live together in relative peace for over a few hundred years.
Where is here? What is the Imperium?
How long have we been here?
How long have I been out there?

No problem. We will progress at your pace, so take all the time you need. There is no rush at all. First things first. You can [lime]CLICK + DRAG[/] this communication box around on the screen. [n][n]You can also [lime]MINIMIZE[/] this window when you need the space. You can resize the window by dragging the resize icon in the bottom right. This can make it easier to see things on screen while following instructions. [n][n]If we happen to lose our connection, you can find me at any of the stations here in Void Starcross.

I understand, I will keep it short and sweet. Let's take a look at the [yellow]STATION SERVICES[/] on the right. Before we can start earning some Credits, [n][n]You need to install that [orange]Ore Harvester[/] from your [yellow]CARGO BAY[/]. Press the [lime]TAB key[/], and open the station [yellow]GARAGE[/].
Wait, I changed my mind... explain this slowly.

Well, I can't exactly say where 'here' is. None of us can. We call this place Astrox, It was the name of the last readable location on our navigational star charts. [n][n]Technically, we have no clue where we are, but at this point, most people don't seem to care much. As for the Imperium, that I can tell you about. The Imperium was the colony ship that was transporting us over 200 light years to a place called the Oasis.
So what happened to the Imperium.

That one we do know. Lucky for us,  one of the atomic power cores from the Imperium was still functional. It is now the very heart of this station, and it has been running for over 230 years. [n][n]When the initial survivors started rescuing each other, they used a damaged power core to activate one of the habitation units that had detached during the explosion. Their quick thinking saved thousands of lives.
So, I have been out there this whole time?

Technically, just as long as everyone else. The only difference being, most of us have been awake while you were asleep. So yes, you have been out there for just about 230 years, give or take a cycle. I know it is a lot to take in, but once you get adjusted, you will find that it is not so bad out here.
So basically I have been napping for the past 2 centuries.

Well see, that's where things get fuzzy again. We have never recovered more than 10% of the wreckage. We do not know where the main core of the ship is. As a matter of fact, it has become quite the pastime to search for the Imperium. Although now, it's mostly the older pilots that still quest for it. [n][n]All the younger pilots have long abandoned the idea. Most think it was all just a myth to inspire the younger pilots to explore. But the evidence is real. The ship did exist.

We don't really know for sure. There are a few theories floating around. Everything from aliens to sabotage... you name it, someone out there has a theory about what happened to the Imperium. The latest ones involve the premise that there never was a ship at all. Bunch of wackos I tell ya. [n][n]I guess after you have been out here alone in the void for so long... anything seems possible.
So how long has this been going on out here?
How long have I been asleep?
What if there really is no ship?

Yes, you have been asleep in your cryo-evac pod this whole time. You are the first refugee we have seen in over 70 years. This station used to be packed with instructors and Newgee pilots, but over the decades, fewer and fewer would arrive, until one day, it just stopped altogether. You friend, are somewhat of a celebrity.

Like I said, it has been quite awhile since we have seen a Newgee in these parts. You might be wondering about your starter ship and those  55,000 Credits in your account. Just some assistance from the Alphas to help get you going. [n][n]There used to be much more support back when we were processing 20-30 refugees a day. Now, there are just a few of us instructors left. [n][n]Don't worry though, us diehard pilots still know all the tricks.
Let's get started with the training.
I'm not ready to train just yet. I want to poke around first.
Just the basics please, I am eager to get out there.

Of course there is a ship. How in the heck would you be here if there wasn't a ship? It's not like we just teleported here.  Just a word of advice, if you start talking that nonsense around here, you will quickly lose your celebrity status with the locals.
I just want to know if the Imperium is real.

No problem. Take your time to explore the station a bit. Even though most of it will seem confusing at first, once you learn the basics, it will become second nature.[n][n] Anyway, I'll be here if you need me. Just [lime]CLICK[/] the station [yellow]OFFICES[/] tab.
Okay, thank you. I won't be long.

Let's take a look at the the station panel. It's over to the right hand side of the screen. Each station has a number of services that will provide you with everything you need to survive out here. Not every station will have every service available, so take note which stations have the services you need. [n][n]There is normally a small docking fee associated with each station, so be mindful of your Credits. You can find those displayed in the upper right.

Each service offered here is very important, so I would highly recommend you take a few minutes to explore what is available. [n][n]It may be a bit overwhelming at first, but don't get discouraged, We will only be focusing on a few of the main services right now. The [yellow]MARKET[/], and the [yellow]GARAGE[/] will probably be the two places you visit most.

Let's open up the MARKET and take a look at what items are available. All of the market items can be sorted using the [yellow]SORT[/] buttons. [lime]MOUSE OVER[/] an item to view more information about the items being bought and sold here. [n][n]You can sell items from your ship's [yellow]CARGO BAY[/], by [lime]CLICKING + DRAGGING[/] them onto the market. Open your [yellow]CARGO BAY[/] by pressing the [lime]TAB[/] key.

[s2][cyan]Intro Tutorial (5 of 10)[/][/s][n]The [yellow]MARKET[/] has a lot to offer, so make sure you take your time and explore the variety of items. Make sure you check each [yellow]PAGE[/] for good deals on items you need. Keep in mind, some items may require some [yellow]SKILLS[/] before you can operate them.[n]So, where do all these items go once you purchase them?

The [yellow]CARGO BAY[/] is where your ship can carry ore, trade goods, ammunition for your turrets. Basically anything you need to carry with you, travels in the [yellow]CARGO BAY[/]. Any equipment that is installed on your ship can be viewed from the station [yellow]GARAGE[/]. Let's open the [yellow]GARAGE[/] and take a look at your starter ship.[n][n]You may notice your starting ship has a few items in the [yellow]CARGO BAY[/] already.  We will need to install a few of these items before undocking into space. The ship's life support system will be able to use those support items, thus helping you last longer in open space with a damaged ship.

The [yellow]GARAGE[/] is where you will install equipment onto your ship. There are 2 type of modules that can be installed. These are [orange]ACTIVE MODULES[/], and [orange]PASSIVE MODULES[/]. You can also access the [yellow]LIFE SUPPORT[/] panel from the GARAGE as well.[n][n]In preparation for our first mission, let's go ahead and install that [orange]Ore Harvester x1[/] from your [yellow]CARGO BAY[/]. Then we will install the two [orange]LIFE SUPPORT[/] items.[n][n]Let's open the station [yellow]GARAGE[/] and make some changes to the ship's configuration.

Before we can install the [orange]Ore Harvester 1[/] onto our ship, we will need to remove the [orange]Pulse x1 Laser[/] to make some room for this [orange]ACTIVE MODULE[/]. Using your mouse,  [lime]CLICK AND DRAG[/] the [orange]Pulse x1 Laser[/] from the GARAGE, and drop it onto your ship's [yellow]CARGO BAY[/] to the left.[n][n]As a shortcut, you can also [lime] RIGHT CLICK[/] any installed module to have it removed from the ship. Before any module can be properly removed, it cannot have any current damage.[n][n] The [yellow]GARAGE[/] will also provide you with the ability to repair your damaged modules. You can also make custom changes to your ship's colors.

See, that was easy. I'm sure you have guessed by now, you can do the exact reverse to install [orange]ACTIVE and PASSIVE MODULES[/] onto a ship. [n][n]Let's install that [orange]Ore Harvester 1[/] by dragging it from the [yellow]CARGO BAY[/], and dropping it onto the empty [orange]ACTIVE MODULE SLOT[/].[n][n]Once you have your modules installed, let's open up the [yellow]LIFE SUPPORT[/] panel by clicking the button on the [yellow]GARAGE[/] panel, or pressing the [lime](K key)[/].With the [yellow]LIFE SUPPORT[/] panel open, we will want to drag and drop the support items onto this panel for installation.[n][n][lime](DRAG and DROP)[/] the [orange]Basic Filter[/] and [orange]Protein Bar[/] onto the [yellow]LIFE SUPPORT[/] panel. You can find more information about the life support systems in the station offices, but for now, this should be enough to keep you safe here in Void Starcross.

[s2][cyan]Intro Tutorial (10 of 10)[/][/s][n]Well look at that, You almost look like a veteran miner with that rusty ship of yours. [n][n]Just let me know when you are ready to mine that first rock, and I will walk you through the process. Don't worry, it is not complicated at all. Some might even say it is relaxing.
I'm ready to mine my first rock.
I will come back to the OFFICES when I am ready.
Welcome back, don't worry, those rocks aren't going anywhere, Just let me know when you are ready and I will walk you through the mission.
I need a refresher, I am confused.
Alright, I think I am ready.
No problem. I have an office at the stations here in Void Starcross. Drop by at anytime.
Never mind, I am ready. Let's do this.

I have given you a special mission. This mission will require that you locate a particular rock out there in space. [n][n]Don't worry, it's not far at all. Once you undock, you will be able to activate the ship's [yellow]TACTICAL SENSORS[/] by pressing the [lime]SPACEBAR[/]. This will show us all the rocks in the sector, and color the mission rock yellow. Let's go, I'll show ya.

Remove the [orange]Pulse x1 Laser[/] by [lime]CLICKING[/] and [lime]DRAGGING[/] the item from the [yellow]GARAGE[/], and drop it onto your [yellow]CARGO BAY[/]. [n][n]Then [lime]DRAG[/] the Ore Harvester 1 onto the empty [orange]ACTIVE MODULE[/] slot in the [yellow]GARAGE[/]. Once you have both mining lasers installed, we can continue.

When you are ready, [lime]CLICK[/] the [yellow]UNDOCK[/] button, and I will be waiting for you on the outside. [n][n]Now is probably a good time to take a look at your [yellow]SHIP STATS[/] panel. Press the [lime]Z key.[/] This will display a bunch of important information about the status of your ship.
Hey, glad to see you are back. Are you ready to mine some rocks?

[s2][cyan]Mining Tutorial (1 of 7)[/][/s][n]If you haven't [yellow]UNDOCKED[/] yet, do that now. [n]Once your ship is launched, You can orient yourself by rotating and zooming the camera. Each time you dock, or undock from a station or structure, Your pilot data will be recorded (Saved). [n][n][lime]HOLD RIGHT CLICK[/] and [lime]MOVE THE MOUSE[/][n]This will rotate the camera around your ship. [n]Use the [lime]MOUSE WHEEL[/] to zoom in and out. [n][n][lime]ZOOM OUT[/] all the way to view the [yellow]GALAXY MAP[/] or use the [lime](M key)[/]. You can also [lime]ZOOM IN[/] all the way to get a first person view from the ship.

[s2][cyan]Mining Tutorial (2 of 7)[/][/s][n]Once you get comfortable with the camera basics, use the [lime]SPACEBAR[/] will activate the tactical sensors, This will allow you to see mission objects and other important locations. The [lime]SPACEBAR[/] will toggle the tactical sensors when you are undocked and in open space. [n][n][lime]ZOOM[/] out and [lime]ROTATE[/] the camera until you can clearly see the yellow rock in view. [lime]CLICK[/] the Special Adamyte rock to target the object. [lime] DOUBLE CLICK[/] will automatically set your ship to travel to that object.[n][n]Press the [lime](T key)[/] to open the [yellow]TARGETING PANEL[/]. The targeting panel will display all of the active targets your ship is currently tracking. [n][n]Keep in mind, this number is limited, so manage your targets wisely until you can upgrade. Large metal objects like stations, structures and warpgates will be remembered by your ship's computer. You will NOT be required to scan them again.

[s2][cyan]Mining Tutorial (3 of 7)[/][/s][n]Once you have the target acquired, there are a few ways of moving your ship to the target. The easiest way to active your [yellow]AUTOPILOT[/], is to [lime]DOUBLE CLICK[/] any item from anywhere. [n][n]This works in Tactical view [lime]SPACEBAR[/], as well as the Map view [lime](M Key)[/]. You can manually toggle the autopilot system by pressing the [lime](E key)[/], or clicking the Autopilot toggle button on the [yellow]AUTOPILOT[/] panel. Some pilots are not a fan of the click and go Autopilot. There is an OPTION under the EXTRAS tab that will allow you to select a scanned target without flying directly towards it instantly.

You can fly the ship around manually as well. Using [lime]WASD[/] on the keyboard will allow you to control your ship. You can also hold down the [lime]LEFT CLICK[/] button to steer the ship as well. [n][n]Most of the time, you will use autopilot... however there are times when you will want to take over the controls, but we will cover that in the combat tutorial. Right now, let's just focus on harvesting this rock.

You should be getting close to that yellow rock by now. Did you forget the [lime]SPACEBAR[/] for a tactical view of the sector? You will have a hard time finding mission objectives without the Tactical Sensors turned on[r]. Once your ship is in range of the asteroid, it will automatically slow down. At this point, you will want to fire up those [orange]Ore Harvester 1[/] by clicking the icon for each one at the bottom center of the screen. They will take a few seconds to cycle through each harvest attempt.[n][n]Press the [lime](TAB key)[/] to open your [yellow]CARGO BAY[/]. Once the ship is full, your miners will deactivate automatically to save energy.[n][n]As your miners begin to cycle, the durability of each module will slowly drop. If you do not repair these modules at the station garage, they will stop working altogether.

Once you have mined enough ore, you will notice a notification pop-up informing you that the mission objectives have been completed. For missions, you only need to mine the required amount. When mining for profit, it is not a bad idea to leave a little rock behind, so it can grow back faster.[n][n]If it is a mission, You can also open a special [yellow]MISSION PANEL[/] via the [yellow]SHIP STATS PANEL[/]. You will find this panel in the lower left of the screen, [lime](Z key)[/]. This box will display the mission objects, and the current objectives of the selected mission. [n][n]You can drag this [yellow]MISSION PANEL[/] around on the screen, and you can also resize the window using the resize button in the lower right.

Now that you have completely harvested the Adamyte, and the mission objective is showing complete...let's head back to the same station to complete the mission I have assigned you. [n][n]Just rotate the camera [lime]RIGHT CLICK + DRAG[/] until you see the station we undocked from.[lime]DOUBLE CLICK[/] on it. Once you click the station, it will scan and pop up on the [yellow]TARGETING PANEL (T key)[/]. Double clicking it will automatically set your ship GPS to that station. Once you are within range, a dock button will appear on the station HUD, and on the targeting panel. [n][n]I will meet you there when you are ready to continue.
I will see you at the station.

Great work out there. I was getting a bit worried that I pushed you too hard. Wait until my brother finds out. He thought you wouldn't be able to mine that rock on your own. Now he has to repair my modules. [n][n]You probably noticed that all modules slowly take damage over time. You better keep those puppies in good working order at all times. Nothing like breaking a module during combat.
No problem at all. What now?

Well, that is it for me I'm afraid. Fredrick should be here any minute now. You can find him at the Tutorial Office. He will walk you through some of the basics of the Combat. [n][n]Anyway, it was really great spending time with you. I feel kind of stupid for asking... but would you mind giving me your autograph? My friends back at 'The Gates' are never going to believe I trained a Newgee today. So what do ya say?
Sure why not, maybe it will be worth something one day.
That is just too much. I'm sorry, I just can't
Oh that's okay, I figured it couldn't hurt to ask. Anyway, I hope to see you around, and tell my brother he owes me a new water filter for my life support system.

Wow, Thank you so much. I will hang this in my locker down at the docks. The girls are going to be so jealous. Anyway, thank you again, and take care out there. Oh yeah, tell my brother I won the bet... and boy is he going to regret it.[n][n] Fredrick is hanging out in the station [lime]OFFICES[/]. He will help you learn how some of those fancy combat systems work on your ship. Just take it slow, there is a lot to learn.

I have added some addition information into your Pilot's Journal. You can access this document any time you need to. Just open up your [yellow]Pilot's Journal[/] and you will find it under DOCUMENTS. Anyway, you take care out there. Stay safe.
Hey there stranger, you are back already. I don't suppose you want to run through my tutorial again. I am always available if you want to give it another go.
No thanks, maybe some other time.
Would you like to continue your training? Fredrick is ready to walk you through the basics of combat. If not, you can always meet up with him at the station offices whenever you are ready.
I am ready, let's do this!
